┌─ Help: The mouse and the sidebar ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ The mouse                                                                                                                                │
│   Click ground      walk there; the server plans the route, inside this zone                                                             │
│   Click mob, person select it and open its card; click again (or F to attack, G to talk) to act                                          │
│   Click loot        pick up everything within reach                                                                                      │
│   Click a marker    walk to it (a scout point, a world event's mark)                                                                     │
│   Hover             its name beside the pointer: a mob, person, door, marker, or you                                                     │
│   Alt, Ctrl+A       name everything on the map (Ctrl+A if your terminal sends no Alt with the mouse)                                     │
│   Wheel, + -        zoom the map                                                                                                         │
│   Right-click, Esc  let go of the selection                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│   A first click never attacks. M opens the large map: click a spot to walk there, or move the cursor with the arrows and press Enter.    │
│   Shift+click is never used: terminals keep it for selecting text. Every mouse action has a key; the game is fully playable without a    │
│   mouse.                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│ The character sidebar                                                                                                                    │
│   C                 the next tab (in a narrow window, holds the sidebar open as a drawer; C or Esc puts it away)                         │
│   PgUp, PgDn        scroll (the wheel does too); click a tab to pick it                                                                  │
│   J                 at a vendor: sell all your junk (no gear slot, wanted by no contract of yours)                                       │
│   A                 at a vendor: sell the whole stack under the cursor                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                          │
│   Beside a trader, a trainer, the bank, a contract board or a conversation sits your character: Gear (what you wear), Bags (what you     │
│   carry, stacked, "Wolf Pelt ×2") and Stats (health, armour, accuracy, what your swing does now, and what gear adds to each attribute).  │
│   Every item says how it compares with what you wear in its slot: ▲ better, ▼ worse, = about the same, x you cannot use it (the card     │
│   says why). What you cannot afford is greyed out with how many crowns you are short.                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                          │
